verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at twilio.com and machine-readable Markdown versions of the SendGrid docs (docs/sendgrid.md with structured TechArticle front-matter), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. The llms.txt is Twilio-wide, and the visible entry is general Twilio content rather than SendGrid-specific. missing for 10: a SendGrid-specific llms.txt or index, first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering (e.g., llms-full.txt or .md coverage across all SendGrid pages), and independent corroboration of agent use.
